body.en: Classification is the process of arranging data into groups or classes according to their common characteristics (resemblances). Objectives: to condense a mass of data, to bring out similarities and differences, to make comparison easy, to remove unnecessary detail, and to prepare the data for tabulation and analysis.
body.kn: ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಎಂದರೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ವರ್ಗಗಳಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು: ಸಂಕ್ಷೇಪಿಸುವುದು, ಹೋಲಿಕೆ ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು, ಕೋಷ್ಟಕೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುವುದು.

say.en: Classification sorts data by a common feature. There are four bases.
By place, by time, by an attribute, or by a variable.
Qualitative classification is simple, with two classes, or manifold, with many. Quantitative uses a discrete or continuous variable.
Examples: literate or illiterate is simple; blood group is manifold; marks are quantitative.

narration.en: On the board: The four types of classification.
Each set of data is classified in one way. Sort it into geographical, chronological, qualitative or quantitative.

text.en: Rainfall in each taluk of Mysuru district
Monthly sales of a shop from April to March
People classified as literate or illiterate
Employees grouped by height in cm

explanation.en: Ask what the classes are made of: places (geographical), periods of time (chronological), an attribute that cannot be measured (qualitative) or a measured variable (quantitative).

body.en: Geographical (spatial): by place, e.g. population by districts. Chronological (temporal): by time, e.g. GDP by years. Qualitative: by an attribute that cannot be measured, such as gender, religion or blood group; it is simple (dichotomous, two classes: literate/illiterate) or manifold (many classes). Quantitative: by a measurable variable such as marks, wages or height.
body.kn: ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ: ಸ್ಥಳದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ. ಕಾಲಾನುಕ್ರಮ: ಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ. ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ: ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗದ ಲಕ್ಷಣದ (ಗುಣ) ಪ್ರಕಾರ; ಸರಳ (ಎರಡು ವರ್ಗ) ಅಥವಾ ಬಹುವಿಧ. ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ: ಅಳೆಯಬಹುದಾದ ಚರಾಂಶದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ (ಅಂಕ, ಕೂಲಿ).

problem.en: Name the type of classification: (a) population of Karnataka's districts; (b) India's GDP from 2015 to 2024; (c) students by blood group; (d) workers by daily wage in ₹; (e) voters as men and women.

steps.en: (c) attribute with many classes: qualitative, manifold.
(e) attribute with two classes: qualitative, simple (dichotomous).

answer.en: (a) geographical (b) chronological (c) qualitative manifold (d) quantitative (e) simple

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Name the type of classification: (a) population of Karnataka's districts; (b) India's GDP from 2015 to 2024; (c) students by blood group; (d) workers by daily wage in ₹; (e) voters as men and women.

body.en: Ask: is it grouped by Place, Time, Attribute or Variable? That gives geographical, chronological, qualitative or quantitative.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿಂದ ಗುಂಪು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಕ್ಷೇಪಿಸಿ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಧಗಳು: ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ, ಕಾಲಾನುಕ್ರಮ, ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ, ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ. ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಸರಳ ಅಥವಾ ಬಹುವಿಧ.
